componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: The owner’s Denmark request is retained; Greenland and Faroes do not inherit it.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: The European geographical Netherlands follows its proposed European completion event.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Caribbean public bodies and other Kingdom countries remain separately uncharted.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Preserve the four ordinary UK country components, including their ordinary offshore islands represented in the same source geometry.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Country membership is distinguished from Crown Dependencies and separately administered overseas areas.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Preserve the European French geographical footprint, including Corsica, under France’s valid puzzle event.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Distant overseas areas are scoped separately; French Guiana keeps its independent approved geographical event.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Norway’s North Atlantic/Arctic components fit the Nordic reach of the approved northern chart. Their ordinary country membership and Northern European geography support one Norway charting event.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Svalbard has a distinct treaty framework; Jan Mayen is not Bouvet. Neither adds a country or playable label.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Recommend following the existing ordinary Spain country entity for these integral cities, rather than treating them as new or lesser countries.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: They are physically in North Africa. This is an explicit proposed component exception to the European focus, not a sovereignty adjudication or a new border challenge. Owner attention requested.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Recommend retaining this Spanish autonomous archipelago with Spain’s valid country event as an explicit Atlantic component extension.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: The islands are off northwestern Africa, not continental Europe. This bespoke scope recommendation does not make every EU outermost region automatic.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Recommend Madeira and Azores with Portugal as its integral autonomous Atlantic regions, an explicit component extension of completed European coverage.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: These are remote Atlantic components; include by this named proposal, not by an automatic sovereign union. No new eligible entity.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Denmark’s requested European country coverage does not automatically mean the whole Danish Realm. Preserve these separately administered, self-governing geographical areas uncharted.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Faroes are geographically Northern European, but proximity alone does not approve a separately governed realm component. This recommendation leaves them unawarded.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: European Netherlands coverage does not represent Caribbean geography. Retain all these components uncharted.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Bonaire/Sint Eustatius/Saba are part of the Netherlands; Aruba/Curaçao/Sint Maarten are other Kingdom countries. Legal membership alone is not a geographic completion grant.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Only the UK’s ordinary four-country geographical footprint follows the UK. Separately administered overseas areas stay unawarded.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: No position on disputed sovereignty or later constitutional changes is introduced; retain source geography as neutral context. Gibraltar’s European location alone does not create an award.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Crown Dependencies do not follow a UK country event.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: They are not part of the UK; their European location does not make them a new approved game exception.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Retain distant French areas uncharted because the French answer and European collection do not automatically represent Caribbean, Indian Ocean or Pacific geography.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Overseas departments can be integral parts of France; the exclusion is geographic display scope, not reduced legal membership. French Guiana has its own existing approved award.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Preserve the existing ordinary-US-state interpretation for Alaska and Hawaii.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Hawaii is Pacific geography. Do not erase an already accepted integral-state treatment merely to make a future gap look larger.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Preserve Åland as an integral autonomous Finnish area within the Northern European reach of the Finland country entry.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Autonomy and demilitarisation do not create an additional playable country or token.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Keep the existing French Guiana geographical exception: only its valid puzzle event charts it.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: Never inherit from France, and never count it as a sovereign country.

componentRecommendations.geographicalReason: Bouvet’s distant southern geography is outside the Norwegian/Northern European chart.
componentRecommendations.membershipAndScopeNote: No Norwegian Antarctic claim layer is added. Antarctica remains separately uncharted.
